item.description:
AppStore++ 2.3.15 | TrollStore
# AppStore++ — What’s New in v2.3.15-7
- Added a delete all/trashcan button for ipa library - Fixed bug when an ipa download is cancelled when packaging & becoming corrupted - Run ipa packaging on background thread so the UI isn't lagged
